sourceCopy.name: Prime Factorization Calculator
sourceCopy.title: Prime Factorization Calculator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Factor positive integers into primes, show division steps and count divisors. Free, exact browser calculator with no sign-up.
sourceCopy.intro: Break a positive whole number into prime factors. See prime powers, repeated factors, the division ladder and how many positive divisors it has. The arithmetic runs locally in your browser.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you find the prime factorization of a number?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Divide by the smallest prime that divides the number, then repeat with the quotient until the remaining value is prime. For example, 360 = 2³ × 3² × 5.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser and this tool does not upload or save your input.

fields.limitsNote: Enter an integer from 1 to 1,000,000,000,000. Factorization uses exact integer arithmetic in this browser.

messages.checkInputs: Enter a positive whole number from 1 to 1,000,000,000,000.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is not available in this browser.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the prime factorization of 360?
How many divisors does a number have?
additionalFaqs.answer: If its prime powers are pᵃ × qᵇ, the divisor count is (a + 1)(b + 1). This calculator shows the count for the supported positive integer.

additionalFaqs.question: Can it factor any size of number?
additionalFaqs.answer: This browser tool accepts whole numbers from 1 through 1,000,000,000,000. Larger values are outside its stated range.
